items.heading: Kung Pao Chicken
details: Key ingredients: chicken, peanuts, dried chilies, sichuan peppercorns, soy sauce
Marinate diced chicken briefly in soy sauce and cornstarch.
Stir-fry dried chilies and sichuan peppercorns in hot oil until fragrant.
Add chicken and stir-fry until cooked through.
Toss in peanuts and a savory-sweet sauce to finish.

items.heading: Fried Rice
details: Key ingredients: cooked rice, eggs, spring onion, soy sauce, mixed vegetables
Scramble eggs lightly in a hot wok and set aside.
Stir-fry day-old rice with vegetables until heated through.
Fold the scrambled eggs back in with soy sauce and spring onion.
Toss everything together over high heat for a minute more.

items.heading: Dumplings (Jiaozi)
details: Key ingredients: flour, minced pork, cabbage, ginger, garlic, soy sauce
Mix minced pork with finely chopped cabbage, ginger, garlic and soy sauce.
Fill small dough wrappers with the mixture and pleat closed.
Boil, steam or pan-fry the dumplings until cooked through.
Serve with a dipping sauce of soy sauce, vinegar and chili oil.

details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
